item.title: Judy Garland’s Death And The Tragic Story Of What Caused It
item.description: Following decades of depression and addiction, movie legend Judy Garland died of a barbiturate overdose in London at age 47 on June 22, 1969. The post Judy Garland’s Death And The Tragic Story Of What Caused It appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: The Remarkable Life Of Peter Freuchen, From His Dangerous Greenland Expeditions To His Fight Against Nazis
item.description: Whether exploring the Arctic, fighting the Nazis, or traveling the world, Peter Freuchen did it all — and then some. The post The Remarkable Life Of Peter Freuchen, From His Dangerous Greenland Expeditions To His Fight Against Nazis appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: How Aron Ralston’s Harrowing Survival Story Inspired ‘127 Hours’
item.description: In April 2003, mountaineer Aron Ralston spent 127 hours pinned by a boulder in Utah's Bluejohn Canyon — until he amputated his own arm and escaped. The post How Aron Ralston’s Harrowing Survival Story Inspired ‘127 Hours’ appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: Hospital Construction In Romania Just Turned Up A Staircase Leading Down Into Ancient Roman Catacombs Containing 34 Graves
item.description: Archaeologists in Constanța, which is built atop the ancient city of Tomis, uncovered skeletons, catacombs, glassware, coins, a Greek inscription, and a piece of a rare ceremonial shield — all dating back to approximately the third century C.E. The post Hospital Construction In Romania Just Turned Up A Staircase Leading Down Into Ancient Roman Catacombs Containing 34 Graves appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: How Did Anthony Bourdain Die? Inside The Beloved Chef’s Troubled Final Days
item.description: Anthony Bourdain was the best-selling author of "Kitchen Confidential" and the celebrated host of "Parts Unknown," but the growing toll of fame and his own troubled relationships led to his suicide in June 2018. The post How Did Anthony Bourdain Die? Inside The Beloved Chef’s Troubled Final Days appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: The Astonishing Story Of Dusko Popov, The World War II Intelligence Agent Who Helped Inspire 007
item.description: Though many spies have been named as the inspiration for James Bond, Duško Popov actually knew Sir Ian Fleming and gambled with him in between his international espionage escapades. item.title: An Archaeology Student Swimming In The Mediterranean Just Happened Upon A Crusader’s Sword From The 12th Century
item.description: Shlomi Katzin found this three-foot blade in the seabed just offshore at Israel's Dor Beach — not far from where he'd found another Crusader's sword in 2021. The post An Archaeology Student Swimming In The Mediterranean Just Happened Upon A Crusader’s Sword From The 12th Century appeared first on All That's Interesting.

item.title: The Chilling Story Of Aleksandr Akimov, The Soviet Engineer Who Was On Duty During The Chernobyl Disaster
item.description: Aleksandr Akimov was a night shift supervisor at the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant, and his attempts to mitigate the effects of the reactor explosion in April 1986 left him with such severe radiation sickness that he was dead within two weeks. The post The Chilling Story Of Aleksandr Akimov, The Soviet Engineer Who Was On Duty During The Chernobyl Disaster appeared first on All That's Interesting.
